data.narrative:
Agile Robots, a Series C robotics and manufacturing company founded by Zhaopeng Chen and Peter Meusel, has raised approximately $384M to date against a last post-money valuation exceeding $1.0B. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of nine private companies and one public entity (277810.KQ) operating in robotics and manufacturing at Series B through Series D stages, including Exotec, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Hadrian, and Nimble Robotics.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applied a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C to next-stage advancement to the $1.0B last post-money, yielding $1.7B. Peer-median analysis across six same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produced a median valuation of $1.7B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $2.0B. Both methods converged on identical implied values, supporting analytical consistency.

The triangulated range is $1.4B (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $1.7B. This reflects the company's stage positioning and capital intensity relative to peer cohort. Key uncertainties include timing and quantum of Series D progression, unit economics validation in target manufacturing verticals, and relative competitive positioning within the robotics subsector. The narrow consensus between methods suggests moderate confidence in the $1.4B–$2.0B band, though execution risk on revenue inflection remains material for any future round.
